An asterisk (*) denotes that a network service is disabled.
(1) Display Controls
(Hardware Port: Display Controls, Device: usbmodemXXXX0001)

(2) USB 10/100/1000 LAN
(Hardware Port: USB 10/100/1000 LAN, Device: en7)

(3) Thunderbolt Ethernet
(Hardware Port: Thunderbolt Ethernet, Device: en9)

(4) Wi-Fi
(Hardware Port: Wi-Fi, Device: en0)

(5) Thunderbolt Bridge
(Hardware Port: Thunderbolt Bridge, Device: bridge0)

(*) iPhone USB
(Hardware Port: iPhone USB, Device: en10)

(7) Tailscale
(Hardware Port: io.tailscale.ipn.macos, Device: )
